description.value:
Your chakra control reaches a new threshold. Your proficiency rank for spell DCs and spell attack rolls with the chakra tradition becomes expert (proficiency 2).

You learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllChrgChak2nd0]{Charge Chakra (Greater)}, the rank-2 variant of Charge Chakra: 1 Focus Point and 1-3 actions restore 2, 4, or 6 expended slots (instead of 1, 2, or 3).
